recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reapply the 2017 context/EpisodeOfCare shape unless a new work-group decision supersedes FHIR-17661, FHIR-33166, and FHIR-42761; any further work on extension search rendering should happen in extension-pack/tooling scope.
issue_request: FHIR-12679 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for DSTU2 Observation asking to make Observation.identifier summary with pattern wording, add name as an alias on Observation.code, rename Observation.encounter to Observation.context with an encounter alias, add EpisodeOfCare to the reference type, and retain an Encounter search parameter.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit 2c8fb553cfc67b9b93eca7789fc412e6e4613d42 (`[#12679], [#9664]`), which changed the old Observation spreadsheet rows for identifier, code alias, context/EpisodeOfCare, and search parameters.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition keeps Observation.identifier summary and Observation.code's Name alias, but uses Observation.encounter Reference(Encounter) with a Context alias and a short-text note pointing EpisodeOfCare users to the workflow-episodeOfCare extension. Later final decisions FHIR-17661 and FHIR-17901 restored encounter plus the EpisodeOfCare extension; FHIR-33166 added only the extension guidance; FHIR-42761 rejected a broad rollback to Event.context/EpisodeOfCare; FHIR-42762 placed the extension search parameter in the FHIR Extension Pack; and FHIR-43456 performed a newer Observation workflow-alignment review without changing the identifier wording or encounter model.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit was warranted because reverting to Observation.context or adding EpisodeOfCare as a core target type would contradict later decisions, while the still-current parts of FHIR-12679 are already present.

related_jiras.note: Changed Observation.context back to Observation.encounter, changed the type back to Reference(Encounter), and moved EpisodeOfCare support to a workflow extension.
Applied the same encounter-plus-EpisodeOfCare-extension approach to the Event and Request patterns.
Revisited Observation EpisodeOfCare support and resolved to add short-text guidance to use workflow-episodeOfCare rather than making a breaking element change.
Rejected a broader Event.context/EpisodeOfCare rollback, supporting the current extension approach.
Defined the workflow-EpisodeOfCare search parameter on the extension rather than on every core resource page.
Performed a newer Observation workflow-alignment review and added selected mappings without changing identifier wording or the encounter model.
